product_metadata.title: Ezy Iron Ironing Board Cover and Pad, Cuts Ironing Time in Half 15x54 inch, Thick Padding, Fits Small, Standard Full Size Extra Wide Large 18x49 inches - Premium Heavy Duty Padded Iron Covers (Silver)
features: Ironing Made Easy: Slashes Your Ironing Time in Half - with revolutionary heat reflection,. Rather than absorbing the heat, it is refected so you can iron both sides of your clothes at the same time for faster ironing. Forget poorly fitting covers that are paper thin and show the ironing board mesh marks on your clothes. Boasting an impressive 500gsm Extra Thick padding, this iron board cover is heavy duty, durable and premium quality.

We have been manufacturing Ezy Iron ironing board covers for over 20 years. We have developed a long lasting ironing cover that is tailored to fit all Standard Size and Full Size Large Boards 15 x 54 inches and also 18 x 49 inches. (Please Note: Ironing Board not included).

Exclusive Modern Fabric Designs to suit any bathroom and laundry room. If you are into sewing, quilting or a busy mom or dad doing the daily ironing, then we know you will love the Ezy Iron cover and acheive wrinkle free clothes in a fraction fo the time.

Will Not Slip or Move on Your Board: The EZY IRON Deluxe Ironing Board Covers come with Innovative Elasticized Edges Bungee-cord style drawstring for easy installation and total tension fit to any board drum tight. This cover is designed to fit most ironing board styles and steam stations, including an iron stand, built in hideaway and over the door type folding ironing boards.
The Ezy Iron iron board cover and pad comes with a 5 Year Warranty: Love it or send it back for a no questions asked refund. Love it, Iron it, Ezy Iron It.
